content.text:
I submitted **index 27 (Sb fraction 0.90)** as the best composition, with a measured EQE of **0.135%**.

I used all 5 EQE measurements and 3 of the 5 XRD measurements:

| Index | Sb fraction | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 8 | 0.42 | 0.0035 |
| 15 | 0.65 | 0.0052 |
| 22 | 0.83 | 0.0075 |
| **27** | **0.90** | **0.135** |
| 29 | 0.91 | 0.0034 |

- **EQE trend:** EQE rose with Sb up to 0.90, then dropped by about 40× at 0.91. The high-EQE region is narrow and sits right around index 27.
- **XRD:** indices 25, 27 and 29 all show the same main phase. A second set of peaks (at Q ≈ 1.915, 2.45 and 2.79 Å⁻¹) gets weaker as Sb increases. That might be a second phase dying out, but I didn't identify it by matching against known structures. The XRD also doesn't explain why index 29 is so much worse than index 27, since their patterns are nearly identical.
- **Not measured:** indices 26 (Sb 0.894) and 28 (Sb 0.904) sit on either side of the best point and could beat it. Given how sharply EQE changes here, that's the biggest remaining uncertainty. Nothing below Sb 0.42 (indices 0–7) was measured either. The model-based suggestion tool proposed that end only because it had no data there; the measured trend gave no sign it would be better.
